name: Selfless
description: Allies within %radius% tile pass %redirect_dmg:pct%% of the damage they take onto this unit instead.

upgrade.summary: Takes %redirect_dmg:pct%% of an ally's damage, and only %self_damage_taken:pct%% of it lands.
details: Of everything redirected onto it, this unit actually takes %self_damage_taken:pct%%. The rest is simply borne away.
A shielded ally in the aura is therefore losing far less than %redirect_dmg:pct%% of the blow to the pair of them.
